name: Pettenderly
tagline: Turn pet photos into portraits worth keeping.
short: Create downloadable AI pet portraits from photos of your cat or dog.
description: Pettenderly is an AI pet portrait studio for cat and dog owners. Upload one to five clear photos of the same pet, choose a style, and create a digital portrait to download. Available looks include watercolor, royal portraits, studio scenes and sunny window-seat settings. You & your pet and Photo cleanup offer additional beta tools; generated faces, markings and details can vary. Pettenderly uses paid credits: one credit per successful image, with no credit charged for failed generations. The product delivers digital images, without physical printing or shipping. Pricing starts at $4.99 for 12 credits; subscriptions start at $9.90 per month. No free generation plan.
how_to_use: Upload one to five clear photos of the same cat or dog, select a portrait style, generate an image using paid credits, and download the result.
